name: Generic aircraft mechanic on a maintenance platform, 84 in platform, 64 in tall
description: Standing scale figure 64 in tall in a cap and vest on the deck of a rolling maintenance platform 84 in high with a 11-step stair, handrails on the stair and three sides of the deck, four legs and four casters. A stand-in, not a person.

params.remarks: Generic symbol; a scale figure, not a person's measurements.
